notes.title: Minor Patch 0.3 - Window Screen Mode support
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have added an option in the settings to select the screen mode.

notes.title: Minor Patch 0.2 - Balance fixes
notes.notes:
Hello! Patch 1.0.2 has been released on Steam! Thank you for your support and your feedback!

Here is a changelog for this patch: 
1. Update for the boss skeleton Morgause's first boss encounter, making the fight with him fairer
2. Balance updates for enemies in Story mode
3. Champion encounter removed on easy Raid dungeon
3. Fixes for localization

notes.title: Underquest is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are thrilled to announce the launch of our game, now available with a 20% release discount.

We hope you'll find immense joy and excitement in playing. If you encounter any questions or issues, please reach out to us via any of our social media or Steam community hub.

Let's explore the Underkingdom together!

notes.title: Underquest full release on April 23rd!
notes.notes:
Our fantasy roguelite game is going to be released on April 23! 

More story content, dungeons, and gameplay mechanics await you! 

Thanks for waiting for the game. We hope it will bring you a lot of fun!

notes.title: Open Playtest Launched!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are excited to announce that we are in the process of preparing for our release in April. Before we go live, we want to test our latest changes and get your feedback. Your opinion is very important to us as we strive to create a game that will be the most enjoyable for players.

We kindly invite you to try out our new features and updates. Simply click on the "Join Playtest" button on our Steam page, and the game will be added to your library!

Thank you so much for your input. We appreciate it!

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Available!
notes.notes:
Our fantasy backpack roguelite game participates in Steam Next Fest with a new demo! Feel free to try out the demo and share your feedback!

New demo contains:
[olist]
[*] Updated tutorial flow
[*] Additional languages support
[*] New UI layout
[*] Extended character animations
[*] Balance fixes and new dungeon content
[/olist]
